review: independent hosted Member Chat preflight/source admission review

findings: Preflight requires MATRX_PROFILE_APPROVED_ORGANIZATION_JSON and MATRX_REVIEWER_MAGIC_LINK_JSON by secret name before it fetches the selected workflow run, artifact metadata, or artifact bytes; missing either name is refused with a specific error.

Valid current de066a247..HEAD history passes proveSource with storeEligibility=false. Current non-runtime member receipt, public guest receipts, matching journals, and two named screenshots are admitted.

Mismatched journal run IDs, unknown journal kinds, unrecognized screenshot names, executable/private receipt suffixes, child paths, src/config/env.ts, pnpm-lock.yaml, package.json, wxt.config.ts, and release workflow changes are refused by focused assertions or direct probes.
No native browser run or workflow dispatch was started. Only GitHub secret names are checked by the implementation; no secret values or private fixture contents were read or printed.

The live read-only GitHub secret-name census confirms MATRX_PROFILE_APPROVED_ORGANIZATION_JSON exists, but MATRX_REVIEWER_MAGIC_LINK_JSON is absent; therefore current admission correctly refuses before run/artifact access, and the member workflow cannot proceed until that separate required secret is present.
evidence: Direct proveSource(de066a247..., ba2a9f9b...) returned storeEligibility=false and admitted the actual current changed-path set plus the two dirty admission scripts.
Direct requireReleaseMemberSource probes rejected private receipt suffix, .mjs suffix, src/config/env.ts, pnpm-lock.yaml, .github/workflows/release.yml, and unrecognized resource-policy.json.
Read-only gh api secret-name census: approvedOrganization=true, reviewerMagicLink=false, totalNamed=13; no values accessed.

findings: Guard is at the real source-admission seam: it evaluates committed history and pending tracked/untracked paths before any costly member workflow run or artifact-link use, and tests exercise path provenance in disposable Git clones.

The admitted evidence patterns remain bounded by exact directories, file shapes, journal run-ID correlation, fixed screenshot names, and rejection cases. No runtime code or second implementation was introduced.

Scope note: member receipt admission accepts any four-digit member-chat-store version and any sufficiently long numeric run ID. This is intentional for repeat non-runtime receipts, but it is broader than the single current v0547 receipt.
gaps: The guard checks secret names only. It cannot prove that the approved organization fixture's secret value is valid without exposing or consuming the private fixture, which was explicitly out of scope.

The approved-organization secret name is present. The separate reviewer magic-link secret name is absent, so functional admission is presently blocked at the existing link-secret gate. No private fixture or secret value was accessed.

owner_ruling.source_acceptance: accepted for bounded preflight and receipt classification
owner_ruling.reason: Missing ephemeral reviewer link is the expected between-run state. It is minted for the existing designated reviewer only at point of use, then removed. Source guards demonstrably refuse absent fixtures; the partial review does not establish product acceptance.
